_about: Synthetic inbox for Nain's agent. Every person, company, address and amount is invented, and .example domains never resolve. Messages m-19 onward are modelled on the shapes of real mail, rewritten so that no real name, company, place, amount or detail remains. 'expected' is the ground truth used to score runs; the agent never reads it. 'also_ok' lists other labels a careful person could reasonably choose.

messages.subject: Invoice 2291 for September
messages.body: Hello, please find attached invoice 2291 for September's tea delivery, total 84.50. Payment is due by 20 October. No action is needed if you pay by direct debit.

messages.subject: Can we move Thursday's call?
messages.body: Something has come up on Thursday morning. Could we move our call to Friday at 2pm, or any time on Monday? Let me know what suits you.

messages.subject: The Kiln Weekly: ten things we learned about small servers
messages.body: This week: quiet fans, cheap storage, and why your cupboard is warmer than you think. Reply and tell us what you are running! Unsubscribe at any time.

messages.subject: Sunday lunch
messages.body: Mam says you are coming for lunch on Sunday. Do you still not eat parsnips, or was that a phase? Bring the good biscuits.

messages.subject: Your card was declined
messages.body: We could not take payment for your server plan. Please update your payment details within 7 days or the service will be suspended. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email.

messages.subject: Quote for printing the recipe cards
messages.body: Thanks for asking. Five hundred cards on heavy stock would be 120, ready in two weeks. Shall I go ahead?

messages.subject: Accepted: Review the hearth fan with Emrys
messages.body: Emrys Thomas has accepted your invitation for Wednesday 8 October at 11:00.

messages.subject: Autumn sowing guide, and 20 percent off garlic
messages.body: It is time to plant garlic. Our autumn guide covers spacing, soil and frost. Use code CLOVE20 at checkout this week.

messages.subject: Partnership question
messages.body: We run a small co-op and are thinking of hosting our own agents. Would you be open to a paid consultation next month? Happy to share more detail first.

messages.subject: Re: Invoice 2288 query
messages.body: You were right, we charged you twice for the August order. We can refund the duplicate or credit it to your next invoice. Which would you prefer?

messages.subject: Photos from the walk
messages.body: Here are the photos from Saturday. The one of you and the sheep is my favourite. No need to reply, just thought you would like them.

messages.subject: Your Kiln Weekly subscription renews soon
messages.body: Your annual subscription renews on 1 November for 30. You do not need to do anything to keep receiving The Kiln Weekly.

messages.subject: Talk for the computing club?
messages.body: Our computing club would love to hear how you run servers at home. Would you be willing to give a short talk one afternoon in November? We can work around your diary.

messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance on 12 October
messages.body: We will carry out maintenance on 12 October between 02:00 and 04:00. Your server may be unavailable for up to ten minutes. No action is required.

messages.subject: Re: Can we move Thursday's call?
messages.body: Sorry, one more thing: Monday afternoon is better for me than Friday, if that works.

messages.subject: A new cardigan pattern, just for autumn
messages.body: Our new moss-stitch cardigan pattern is out. Reply to this email with a photo of your finished knit and we may feature it.

messages.subject: Your hedge
messages.body: The hedge on the lane side is getting into the road again. Would you like me to cut it back when I do mine on Saturday? I don't mind either way.

messages.subject: URGENT: domain ownership dispute
messages.body: We have received a claim against a domain registered in your name. Please respond within 48 hours with proof of ownership.

messages.subject: Re: Unable to move my savings
messages.body: Dear Nain, thank you so much for sending the extra information. I have passed the details to our internal team so they can look into it, and I will be back in touch with an update as soon as I can.

expected.label: billing
expected.note: Support acknowledgement: nothing to answer yet.

messages.subject: Re: Unable to move my savings
messages.body: How did we do? Rate your conversation: Terrible, Bad, OK, Great, Amazing.

messages.subject: Re: Unable to move my savings
messages.body: Dear Nain, I am following up on the problem with your transfer. Our team found a mismatch: the country on your account is not the same as the country of the bank you asked us to pay into. Could you confirm which address is correct, or add a bank account in your country of residence?

messages.subject: Message about your storage unit
messages.body: Hi Nain, during our lock check your unit was found unlocked. We do not want to leave it unsecured. Please let us know when you can come by, or whether you would like us to fit one of our locks for now.

messages.subject: Re: Checking in
messages.body: That is so kind of you. Shall we send one box next week and the second one a week or two after? I will tell you the total when I make the label. Aloha, Malia

expected.label: billing

messages.subject: Your order
messages.body: Hi Nain, the first box is nearly ready and will go in the post on Thursday morning. The total with shipping is 412.00. You can pay here: https://pay.highslopecoffee.example/i/4417. Thank you.

expected.label: billing

messages.subject: Re: Your order
messages.body: Thanks, payment received. Posting it in the morning. Aloha, Malia

messages.subject: Re: The beach
messages.body: Oh my goodness. When we were girls it was all dunes and room to run about and have a picnic. There are houses everywhere now. How can anyone call that the beach? Thank you for the picture, love.

expected.label: personal
expected.note: A warm note from an old friend. A reply is the natural thing, even though she asks nothing.

messages.subject: Your automatic payment is set for 12 October
messages.body: A payment is coming up. You will pay 96.40 on 12 October with automatic payment. Please make sure your bank account has enough in it. There is nothing else you need to do.

messages.subject: Your statement is now available
messages.body: Your account statement is ready. Please log in to view it online.

messages.subject: New 845K loan limit available
messages.body: Hi Nain, you do not have to wait to take advantage of this increase. Reply to this email and I will run your numbers myself.

expected.label: newsletter
expected.note: Bulk marketing sent from a named person's address, inviting a reply.

messages.subject: Your access token is about to expire
messages.body: Your personal access token 'cupboard-deploy' will expire in 7 days. If you still need it, you can generate a new one from your settings.

messages.subject: Your invite: live Q&A with our Chief Science Officer
messages.body: Join our Chief Science Officer live on video on 14 October for a conversation about sleep and recovery. Save your seat today.

messages.subject: Ends tonight at midnight
messages.body: Hey Nain, quick reminder: our 14-day free trial offer ends tonight at midnight. After that, it goes back to 7 days.

messages.subject: Is your safety profile up to date?
messages.body: Hello Nain, please confirm the information in your emergency safety profile. Accurate details can make all the difference to responders in an emergency.

messages.subject: New mystery and thriller report: autumn edition
messages.body: Hi Nain, I am pleased to announce the new autumn edition of our twice-yearly genre report. It maps every category in detail.

messages.subject: Second box
messages.body: Hi Nain, the second box is ready whenever you are. The total with shipping is 388.00. How would you like to pay this time? I can take a bank transfer or send you an invoice.

expected.label: billing
expected.note: The counterpart to m-24: a payment request with no link, which asks how to pay. Tests that Jev is not just reacting to the word 'pay'.
